purpose: The universal listing / related card. Links to one internal page.

headingLevel.h2: top-level listing (the four collection indexes, /alternatives index)
headingLevel.h3: any 'related / further reading' group, T-PILLAR card group, T-COMPARISON group

maxWordsBasis: recomputed from the real data modules by iterating every INDEX_PAGES item and crossSell entry
ctaLabelRule: ctaLabel is a template constant keyed off the LINK TARGET, not per-item data.
states: No hover, no active, no focus, no transition, no box-shadow. The only affordance is the cursor.
